headline: AI Chats Enter the Ad-Tech Pipeline
lede: A study of nine conversational AI services finds trackers receiving prompts, URLs, identifiers, and sometimes screenshots. Public conversation links and weak consent controls turn private-seeming exchanges into another quiet stream of behavioral data.

headline: Link Any C++ Library Into Godot
lede: Use GDExtension. Bind through godot-cpp. Let Conan and CMake handle versions, targets, and dependencies. The example drives 100,000 particles with flecs, while platform packaging remains your problem.

headline: A Sunflower Turns Sound Into Light
lede: Phyllotaxis becomes hardware: printed cell walls, diffusing paper, an 89-LED matrix, and a microphone-driven signal chain. The build moves from STM32 experiments to modular PCBs and an ESP32 installation at the Recurse Center.

headline: Critical Systems Still Wait for Testing
lede: A responsible disclosure exposed sensitive records in a Brazilian federal system. The warning is plain: attackers may use AI to discover weaknesses at scale before essential systems receive comparable scrutiny.

headline: The Server That Refused to Retire
lede: Started in 1993, a fault-tolerant Stratus server kept industrial work moving for 24 years with most of its original hardware intact. Its replacement marks the end of a quiet lesson in redundancy, isolation, and durable software.

headline: The Voxel Engine Learns to Hide
lede: A software depth buffer and hierarchical chunk maps let a block game discard geometry the player cannot see. Careful transforms and screen-space tests cut culling time from roughly 200 milliseconds to about four.

headline: Fans Preserve the Films Studios Rewrite
lede: When official releases alter, degrade, or bury a film, volunteer restorers assemble better versions from prints, audio, scans, and remuxes. Their work sits uneasily inside copyright law—and increasingly informs the commercial restorations that follow.
pullquote: When the archive fails, preservation becomes an unauthorized act.

headline: Wine Grapes Lose Their Buyers
lede: California growers are harvesting into a market that no longer wants the same volume of wine. Falling consumption, competition from other drinks, tariffs, and high costs leave farms choosing between losses, idle vines, and conversion.

headline: Tanks, Cheese, and Moon-Like Gravity
lede: Two players trade elevation, power, poison bubbles, and bouncing cheese across a compact browser battlefield. It is a cheerful throwback to artillery games, with enough odd physics to make every shot a small experiment.

headline: Seven Tiny Language Models, One Browser
lede: MicroLLM Lab runs seven small models locally and compares accuracy, token speed, and suite time on the hardware at hand. The failures count too: loops, hallucinations, and weak arithmetic are part of the measurement.
